ipos.prose:
As of today, the SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO grey market premium is ₹45 at the median of 7 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹22 and ₹45. The median has climbed ₹15 since yesterday, a sign of strengthening unofficial demand. Note the disagreement: trackers are 51.1% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹118 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 38.14%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 19.93× overall — strong. The issue is open for bidding now (17-21 Sept) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (63/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. On the timeline, the SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 22 Sep, with listing expected 24 Sep 2026. For the SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹42.52 Cr. See also SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO subscription status and SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO allotment status. This SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

For the Kheria Autocomp IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹46.44 Cr. See also Kheria Autocomp IPO subscription status and Kheria Autocomp IPO allotment status. That is ₹36 below yesterday's median — the premium has cooled a step. Set against the upper price band of ₹1785, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 4.43% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 2.01× overall — healthy. The issue is open for bidding now (17-21 Sept) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (68/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the NSE IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 22 Sep, with listing expected 24 Sep 2026. For the NSE IPO, one lot is 8 shares and the issue size is ₹22,562 Cr. See also NSE IPO subscription status and NSE IPO allotment status. This NSE IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
The Jindal Supreme IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹29 today, drawn from 6 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹25 to ₹30. That is ₹2 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Trackers differ by about 17.2% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Measured off the ₹93 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 31.18%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 203.3× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (79/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the Jindal Supreme IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 21 Sep, with listing expected 23 Sep 2026. For the Jindal Supreme IPO, one lot is 161 shares and the issue size is ₹124.88 Cr. See also Jindal Supreme IPO subscription status and Jindal Supreme IPO allotment status. This Jindal Supreme IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

As of today, the Veegaland Developers IPO grey market premium is ₹6 at the median of 1 tracker, with quotes spread between ₹6 and ₹6. The median has slipped ₹2.5 since yesterday, pointing to softening unofficial demand.

On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 10.61× overall — strong. Our confidence grade on today's number is low (33/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. See also Veegaland Developers IPO subscription status. This Veegaland Developers IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.
